C07 nonetheless provides the closest material drafting template.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Our knowledge and understanding of the materials position of the United States and of its allies throughout the free world will be considerably increased by the detailed review which has been prepared by the Commission.","parent_excerpt":"Your Commission's report is a landmark in its field.
